test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven friends S, T, U, V, W, X and Y, each has a different age. W is older than X but younger than V. Only three people are older than V. T is older than U but younger than S. Y is the youngest among all. How many persons are younger than U?
solution:
**Friends : ** S, T, U, V, W, X and Y

1) W is older than X but younger than V. Only three people are older than V.

⇒ _ > _ > _ > V > W > X > _

2) Y is the youngest among all. 

⇒ _ > _ > _ > V > W > X > Y

3) T is older than U but younger than S. 

⇒** S > T > U > V > W > X > Y**

**4 persons are younger than U** (i.e. V, W, X, Y).

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
